issue.title: Spell formulas do not use `base_power` and use outdated level scaling
issue.body:
**Summary**

Player spell damage formulas have two problems: most spells ignore the per-spell `base_power` parameter entirely, and the level contribution uses the pre-patch 13.05.12657 formula instead of the current one.

---

**Level formula**

Since patch 13.05.12657 (October 2022), Tibia uses:

```
S = floor((sqrt(2L + 2025) + 5) / 10)
B(L) = floor((L + 1000) / S) + 50*S - 450
```

The server still computes level contribution as `level / 5`, which was the pre-patch behaviour.

---

**`base_power` not applied**

Each spell has a `base_power` value that should scale its damage relative to other spells in the same category. Most spells — particularly those going through the C++ `COMBAT_FORMULA_LEVELMAGIC` path — do not use this value at all. As a result, spells that should deal different amounts of damage produce near-identical output.

---

**Affected code paths**

- `getLevelFormula` / `COMBAT_FORMULA_LEVELMAGIC` in C++ — hardcodes `level*2 + mlvl*3`, no `base_power` input.
- Lua callbacks (`CALLBACK_PARAM_LEVELMAGICVALUE`) — receive `level` and `maglevel` but most do not factor in `base_power`.

---

**Scope**

Fix requires updating both the level scaling formula and ensuring every spell formula reads and applies its `base_power`.

issue.title: Sorcerer crippling auras apply swapped stance (exori kor tempo triggers Expose Weakness instead of Sap Strength)
issue.body:
## Bug
The Sorcerer "crippling" aura spells (`exori kor tempo` / `exori moe tempo`) set the
wrong `Stance_t`, so the debuff applied by `applyCripplingStanceAura`
(src/creatures/combat/combat.cpp) is the opposite of what the incantation implies.

### Expected
Mirroring the direct (non-aura) sibling spells:
- `exori kor tempo` -> STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH    -> targets deal -10% damage (persistent, every hit)
- `exori moe tempo` -> STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS -> targets take +8% elemental damage (persistent, every hit)

(`exori kor` = Sap Strength, `exori moe` = Expose Weakness — see
data/scripts/spells/support/sap_strength.lua and expose_weakness.lua.)

### Actual
- `exori kor tempo` sets STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS -> applies +8% elemental damage taken (wrong)
- `exori moe tempo` sets STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH   -> applies -10% damage dealt (wrong)

### Root cause
The two aura Lua files have the stance constants swapped relative to their
`spell:words(...)` and to the direct spells:
- data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_exposed_weakness.lua (words "exori kor tempo") uses STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS
- data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_sapped_strength.lua (words "exori moe tempo") uses STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH

applyCripplingStanceAura reads the caster's stance and applies the matching debuff,
so the inverted constants cause the swapped effect.

## Proposed fix
Swap the constants so they match the direct spells:

data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_exposed_weakness.lua
-  if player and player:getStance() == STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS then
+  if player and player:getStance() == STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH then
...
-      player:setStance(STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS)
+      player:setStance(STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH)

data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_sapped_strength.lua
-  if player and player:getStance() == STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH then
+  if player and player:getStance() == STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS then
...
-      player:setStance(STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH)
+      player:setStance(STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS)

## Steps to reproduce
1. Log in as Sorcerer.
2. Cast `exori kor tempo`.
3. Hit a creature repeatedly.
4. Observe the target receives the Expose Weakness effect (+8% elemental damage
   taken) instead of the intended Sap Strength effect (-10% damage dealt).

## Affected files
- data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_exposed_weakness.lua
- data/scripts/spells/support/aura_of_sapped_strength.lua
- (consumer) src/creatures/combat/combat.cpp -> applyCripplingStanceAura

comments.body:
To clarify the root cause: the Stance_t constants and the C++ applyCripplingStanceAura handler were correct all along — the only bug is that the incantation words are swapped between the two aura files:

aura_of_exposed_weakness.lua uses words("exori kor tempo") but is wired to STANCE_EXPOSE_WEAKNESS
aura_of_sapped_strength.lua uses words("exori moe tempo") but is wired to STANCE_SAP_STRENGTH
So exori kor tempo was triggering the Expose Weakness effect, and exori moe tempo the Sap Strength effect (inverted from what the words imply). The minimal fix is to swap the spell:words(...) lines between the two files and leave the stances untouched. This also keeps each spell's stance client-id aligned with its own spell id, so the stance icon shown matches the spell that was actually cast.

issue.title: Gems with cooldown reduction dont work
issue.body: Any gems dont apply cooldown reduction i'm tested with avatar and divine grenade.
issue.display_title: Gems with cooldown reduction dont work

structuredContent.title: Gems with cooldown reduction dont work
structuredContent.display_title: Gems with cooldown reduction dont work

comments.body:
So... 
The Divine Grenade cooldown reduce gem is realy not working. 
To fix u need to change the cooldown formula at divine_grenade.lua to a normal formula
remove: 
``` 	
	local cooldownByGrade = { 26, 20, 14 }
	local cooldown = cooldownByGrade[grade]

	local condition = Condition(CONDITION_SPELLCOOLDOWN, CONDITIONID_DEFAULT, 258)
	condition:setTicks((cooldown * 1000) / configManager.getFloat(configKeys.RATE_SPELL_COOLDOWN))
	creature:addCondition(condition)
```

and substitute:
```
spell:cooldown(1000) -- Cooldown is calculated on the casting
```
to:
```
spell:cooldown(26 * 1000)
```
Doing that the gem cooldown gonna start working correctly.

About the Avatar one, its working perfectly in my tests.
Stage 1 Avatar - 120min cd
Stage 2 Avatar - 90min cd
Stage 3 Avatar - 60min cd

Apart from that, each gem reduce 15min cd.

U just need to remember that cooldown reduction have a cap. 
U can only reduce haf of the normal cooldown. 
So in the Avatar case, your lowerst coodown will aways gonna be 60min. Even if u have 4 cooldown avatar gem + 3 stage avatar, your cooldown will be 60min.

Another example is the Divine Grenade. The normal cooldown is 26s so the lowest possible is 13s(14s). So even if u put your divine grenade at stage 3 and use 4 cooldown gems, the lowest cooldown gonna be 13s(14s).

I'm probably gonna push a pr fixing the divine grenade shit soon when i have time.

issue.title: bug serene monk
issue.body: monk remains serene even with more than 5 adjacent creatures.

comments.body:
its not a bug. Monks almost always achieve this state but will lose it if party members are nearby and if they have 6 or more monsters adjacent to them. That means monks who are not in a party will always be serene.

https://tibia.fandom.com/wiki/Serene
